description: A pulse shaper modelled on the kick drum circuit of a TR-808: a trigger makes a pulse, the circuit rounds it into an envelope, and a second spike follows at the end of it

params.text: Sets how long the pulse lasts before the shaping circuit, 1ms to 300ms
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall away, 10ms to 300ms
Sets the level of the second spike at the end of the pulse. At the centre the spike is removed; clockwise it returns the other way up and twice as large, anticlockwise it keeps its sign and grows.

inputs.text: Adds to the pulse width knob at a tenth of the knob's range per volt
Adds to the decay knob at a tenth of the knob's range per volt
Adds to the double tap knob at a tenth of the knob's range per volt
A rising edge past 1V starts a new pulse

outputs.text: The shaped envelope, at ten times the circuit's own output

notes: nothing comes out until something is patched into the trigger input; the circuit is at rest otherwise.
fed into ChowModal it does what the pulse does in an 808, exciting a tuned resonance rather than being heard on its own.
the module has no menu of its own beyond Rack's.
